```
def _get_optional_elem(anno: Any) -> Any:
    """Extract the element type from an Optional annotation."""
    if _is_optional(anno):
        # For Optional[X], anno is Union[X, NoneType], so we want the type that's not NoneType
        return next(arg for arg in anno.__args__ if arg is not NoneType)
    return anno
```
